decision.evidence_summary: Tested preserve/reschedule/reroute (OPTIMAL forecasts, repairs 95/115/135). Nominal weighted tardiness: preserve 919, reschedule 681, reroute 401. Worst-case: 1199/881/508. Objective (100*WT+shift+30*reroute+makespan): preserve 92192, reschedule 69011, reroute 41331. Trade-offs: reroute has fewer on-time (2 vs reschedule 4), 3 reroutes (+12-min overhead each), shift 889 vs 616, but lowest tardiness/makespan (252 vs 295/292). Select reroute to protect priority-weighted commitments.

decision.evidence_summary: Preserve baseline forecast: weighted tardiness 596, on-time 2/8, makespan 272. Reschedule tested: 416 tardiness, makespan 267, shift 210, 0 reroutes. Reroute tested: 403 tardiness, makespan 254, shift 261, 1 reroute. Reroute gives lowest priority-weighted tardiness (-193 vs preserve, -13 vs reschedule) and shortest makespan, at cost of +51 shift minutes and 1 rerouted op vs reschedule. Numerical objective lowest for reroute (40845 vs 42077 reschedule vs 59872 preserve). Forecasts only, not guarantees.
